configurations.name: tutoria-web
runtimeArgs: source .venv/bin/activate && (lsof -ti :8000 >/dev/null 2>&1 || (TUTORIA_DB=/tmp/tutoria-dev.sqlite nohup python -m uvicorn app.server.main:app --port 8000 --reload --log-level warning >/tmp/uvicorn.log 2>&1 &)) && sleep 2 && cd app/web && exec npx vite
